about: The Online Stopwatch is a precise digital timer that measures elapsed time from start to stop. Perfect for sports timing, productivity tracking, cooking, workouts, or any activity requiring accurate time measurement.
Features lap timing, split times, and can run continuously in the background. The stopwatch maintains accuracy even when switching between browser tabs or applications.
howToUse: Use lap button to record split times
Click stop to pause the timer
Reset to clear and start over
View lap times and total elapsed time

faqs.question: How accurate is the stopwatch?
faqs.answer: The stopwatch is accurate to milliseconds and uses high-precision browser timing APIs for reliable measurements.

faqs.question: Can I record multiple lap times?
faqs.answer: Yes, you can record unlimited lap times during a timing session, with each lap showing both split and cumulative times.

faqs.question: Does it work in the background?
faqs.answer: Yes, the stopwatch continues running accurately even when you switch to other browser tabs or minimize the window.

faqs.question: What happens if I accidentally close the browser?
faqs.answer: The timing will be lost if you close the browser. For important timing sessions, keep the tab open or use the lap feature to record intermediate times.
